What happens in the room

You won't be left guessing.

Each class is coached total-body conditioning. Kelsey demonstrates, adjusts, and helps you choose the version that works for your body that day.

  • Dumbbells, stability balls, and medicine balls
  • Resistance bands and body-weight movements
  • Cardio and fitness machines
  • Options for different starting points
Your class choices

Pick the days that fit this week.

Your days can change. If you miss one, come to another class during the same session.

Tuesday6:00–7:00 a.m.
Wednesday7:00–8:00 p.m.
Saturday9:00–10:00 a.m.

Missed classes are not refundable and cannot carry into a future session. Full payment is due before the program begins.

More than the workout

Someone will ask how your week really went.

Nutrition and habit coaching are part of the session through check-ins and direct accountability with Kelsey. The goal is not a perfect report card. It is noticing what worked, what didn't, and what support would help next.

You will be asked: What went well? What didn't? What is your goal this week? What do you need from me?

Coming next

A December mini session follows.

After the first six-week session wraps, Focus on You returns December 1–19 for a shorter three-week edition. October is the place to start if you want the full experience.
